description.zh:
驱动通道ID列表。调用[QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~)接口获取通道ID。

> 单次调用最多可填写20个通道ID。
description.en:
A list of channel IDs of the driver. You can call the [QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~) API to obtain channel IDs.

> You can specify a maximum of 20 channel IDs in a single request.

description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The driver ID. You can obtain the ID by moving the mouse pointer over the target driver name on the **Driver Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to obtain the driver ID.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by moving the mouse pointer over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the edge instance ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

title.zh: 批量删除边缘实例中驱动的通道
title.en: Batch Delete Channels of a Driver in an Edge Instance

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-delete-edge-instance-channel --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --driver-id 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592000000 --channel-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
